title: Settings list in the Você tab
summary: The Configurações section of the Você tab: one row per settings group, in the order of registries/settings.json root. Each row shows the current state as its subtitle, so the list reads as a summary (ADR 0112).

key.description: The group key from registries/settings.json (privacy, account, notifications, chats, help).

title.description: String key of the group title.

summary.description: The subtitle, already formatted. Absent when the group has no state to sum up.

needsAttention.description: true only for account when the account has one way back or none. The only warning mark in Settings.

rows.description: The groups of root, in order.

appear.effect: Builds rows from the generated BipeSettings root. Reads the summaries: privacy from GET /v1/me/messaging, account from the ways back (see notes), notifications from the system permission. Shows the rows at once and fills the summaries when they arrive.

openGroup.effect: Opens settings-group for that key. notifications opens the notifications settings screen of bipe-chat/bipe#565.

notes: The order, keys and titles come from the generated BipeSettings (registries/settings.json root and groups). Never hard-code the order. A new group needs a new ADR (ADR 0112).
Privacy summary: everyone → bipe_settings_privacy_summary_everyone, verified → bipe_settings_privacy_summary_verified, contacts → bipe_settings_privacy_summary_contacts.

Account summary, the ways back: a confirmed recovery email (GET /v1/me/account), a linked Apple or Google account (ADR 0096), a recovery key (Encryption.recoveryState is enabled), and the recovery token synced to this phone's platform account. 0 → bipe_settings_account_paths_none; 1 → bipe_account_paths_warning; 2 or more → bipe_settings_account_paths with the count. needsAttention for 0 or 1. The Você tab icon never shows this mark (ADR 0112).
Notifications summary: bipe_settings_notifications_on, or bipe_settings_notifications_off when the system permission is off.

The rest of the Você tab (header with photo, name and @, account switcher, Anotações, Perfil de confiança, Convidar pessoas) is the people and profiles spec (bipe-chat/bipe#567). profile (Seu perfil) opens from the header, not from this list.

Bipe logic: BipeWaysBack (count, needsWarning, summary) and BipeWhoCanMessage.settingsSummary in BipeKit BipeSettingsSupport.swift; BipeWayBack.kt and BipePrivacySettings.kt in libraries/bipe settings.
A personal account has a Meus agendamentos row (bipe_agenda_my_bookings) after the groups; it opens agenda-my-bookings.

No Matrix or Element words in any row: no sala, sessão, dispositivo, criptografia, chave, homeserver (ADR 0112). Bipe has no haptics setting of its own: the system setting wins (design/haptics.md rule 6).
